entries.definitionEn: As time passes; gradually over a period of time.
entries.usageEn: Describes a gradual change or development. It can appear at the beginning or end of a sentence.
entries.usageZh: 强调变化在一段时间内逐渐发生，常与 improve、change、develop、increase、decrease 等动词搭配，可放在句首或句末。

examples.en: Your English will improve over time.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，你的英语会逐渐进步。

examples.en: Over time, small changes can make a big difference.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，微小的变化也能带来很大的影响。

examples.en: The pattern becomes clearer over time.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，这个规律变得更加清晰。

entries.noteEn: Over time describes gradual change; in time means early enough or eventually; on time means at the scheduled time. Overtime (one word) means extra working time or extra time in a sports match.
entries.noteZh: over time 强调“随时间逐渐变化”；in time 表示“及时”或“最终”；on time 表示“准时”。注意 overtime 连写是另一个词，表示“加班（时间）”或“加时赛”。

entries.definitionEn: With flowers fully open; also at a highly developed stage.
entries.usageZh: 常接在 be 后面，形容花盛开，也可用于比喻。

examples.en: The cherry trees are in full bloom.

entries.noteEn: In bloom means flowering; full adds the idea of the peak flowering stage.
entries.noteZh: in bloom 是开花；full 强调盛开。

entries.definitionEn: To have an effect on someone or something.
entries.usageEn: Use make a difference to someone or something.
entries.usageZh: 常用 make a difference to，形容带来影响或改变。

examples.en: A short break can make a difference to your concentration.
examples.zh: 短暂休息可以改善你的专注力。

entries.noteEn: A difference between two things means a distinction; make a difference means to have an effect.
entries.noteZh: a difference between 指差别；make a difference 指产生影响。

entries.definitionEn: In danger of experiencing something harmful.
entries.usageEn: Follow of with a noun or an -ing form.
entries.usageZh: of 后接名词或动名词。

examples.en: They are at risk of losing their jobs.

entries.noteEn: At risk means in danger; take a risk means to do something despite uncertainty.
entries.noteZh: at risk 指处于风险中；take a risk 指冒险。

entries.definitionEn: Used to contrast one choice or situation with another.
entries.usageEn: Follow to with a noun phrase or an -ing form.
entries.usageZh: 这里 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

examples.en: The course focuses on practice as opposed to theory.
examples.zh: 这门课程侧重实践而非理论。

entries.noteEn: Opposed to can mean against; as opposed to introduces a contrast.
entries.noteZh: be opposed to 可指反对；as opposed to 用于对照。

entries.definitionEn: To use an opportunity or resource as effectively as possible.
entries.usageEn: Use with time, opportunities, or available resources.
entries.usageZh: 常与时间、机会或已有资源搭配。
collocations: make the most of your time
make the most of an opportunity

examples.en: Make the most of your time off.
examples.zh: 充分利用你的休假时间。

entries.noteEn: Make the most of does not mean make the majority of something.
entries.noteZh: 这是固定表达，不是“制作其中的大多数”。

entries.definitionEn: To consider carefully before making a decision.
entries.usageEn: Follow about with a noun or an -ing form.
entries.usageZh: about 后接名词或动名词；常暗示行动前应谨慎。

examples.en: Think twice about sending work emails at midnight.
examples.zh: 深夜发送工作邮件前要三思。

entries.noteEn: Think twice before doing is another common construction.
entries.noteZh: 也常用 think twice before doing。
